title: 1946 military search of Swedish lakes for ghost rockets

tellings.quote:
And in 1946, as we talked about the
ghost rockets, uh, the military were
looking for them in several different
lakes around Sweden. All they found were
indentations at the bottom.

plain: In 1946, when Swedes were reporting "ghost rockets", rocket-like objects streaking across the sky, the Swedish military searched several lakes for anything that had come down. According to the Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn, who tells it from his study of the cases, all they found were indentations at the bottom of the lakes, marks that suggest something hit but left nothing behind.
